# semaphore_ex_ldap_group_reconcile (Action)

Reconciles LDAP group mappings immediately and changes role assignments. This is not a dry run. Executes only through explicit Action invocation. Progress reports a bounded, non-secret summary.

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "semaphore_ex_ldap_group_reconcile" "example" {
  config {
    provider_id = "directory"
  }
}

# terraform apply -invoke=action.semaphore_ex_ldap_group_reconcile.example
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `provider_id` (String) Configured identity provider ID.
